annotation.title_clean: 無人載具科技創新實驗條例
annotation.title_en: Unmanned Vehicles Technology Innovative Experimentation Act
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Taiwan Legislative Yuan / Ministry of Economic Affairs (competent authority)
annotation.venue: Laws and Regulations Database of the Republic of China
annotation.summary_en: Taiwan's 2018 Act establishing a regulatory sandbox for unmanned vehicles (land, air, sea). It sets application, review and approval procedures under the Ministry of Economic Affairs, temporary exemptions from traffic and related laws, and safety, insurance, data retention, incident reporting and disclosure obligations.
key_provisions_or_claims: Applicants need Ministry of Economic Affairs approval for experiments of up to one year, extendable to four years in total.
Approved experiments may be exempted from listed traffic, aviation, shipping and telecom laws, but not from civil or criminal liability.
Applications must include risk management, insurance, a data recorder, and communication links that let operators retake control.
Applicants must report human interventions monthly, retain records for three years, and suspend and report safety incidents.
Participants and stakeholders are protected through fair contract terms, a duty of care and public disclosure of experiments.
